item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 04/May/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring slightly cooler weather to Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be showers over the region. With the upper-air disturbances departing and the northeast monsoon moderating, showers will ease off with temperatures rising progressively over the coast of southern China midweek this week. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China towards the weekend.
